description: This file defines a controller class 'SubscriptionStatus' within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages CRUD operations, listing, and display of subscription statuses in the admin interface, including handling of permissions, language loading, URL generation, and view rendering.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription statuses in the admin panel of OpenCart. Handles listing, form display, saving, and deleting subscription statuses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the subscription status list page, setting up breadcrumbs, titles, and subviews.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the subscription status list view, primarily used as an endpoint.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats a list of subscription statuses with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a subscription status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to create or update a subscription status, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription statuses after checking permissions and dependencies.
